system.description:
Druids who give up some of their spells to live in the beast's skin: the shapechangers of the deep wilds, at home in claw and wing.

  • Reshapes: Wild Shape.
  • Spells: you cast from the Spells Per Day row one below your Druid level (never lower than the 1st-level row), and never gain slots above 7th level.
  • Bonus slots from high Wisdom use the spell levels your row gives.
  • Cantrips are unchanged.
  • Animal Shapes and Shapechange are on your list as 7th-level spells.
  • Beast Shape (1st): your Wild Shape has no Level cap (forms up to two-thirds of your Druid level), and can also take these beast-like monsters: Owlbear, Death Dog, Hippogriff, Griffon, Ankheg, Bulette, Grick, Grick Alpha, Hook Horror, Young Remorhaz, Piercer, Rust Monster, Wyvern, Grey Render, Gorgon, Umber Hulk, Behir and Chimera (others at the GM's call; never a swarm, a spellcaster or a creature marked Solo).
    • These forms don't gain Swallow.
    • A form with a breath weapon or gaze can use it once each time you take the form, saved against your spell DC.
  • Wild Shape Casting (5th): while in Wild Shape you can cast your cantrips and your prepared spells of 1st and 2nd level; the beast's voice and movements serve for their components. Your Wisdom modifier applies normally.
  • Primal Strikes (9th): your natural attacks in Wild Shape count as magical, and Wild Shape Casting reaches spells of 4th level. While in Wild Shape you may change from one form to another as your action without spending another use (Deepened Shape); the new form starts with the HP the old form had left, never more than its own maximum.
